context: Shared TLS client fingerprint of the credential-harvesting fleet; links 64 hosts this week across Bucklog SARL (AS211590, France, 18 hosts in the fingerprint view) and the 3xK Tech range (AS200373, 46), all running the identical secret-harvesting toolkit. Durable hunt pivot as the hosts rotate.

Bucklog SARL, AS211590, France. Measured core of the harvesting fleet in the GreyNoise corpus this week: 21 active hosts in the /24 in the session corpus (18 of them carry the fleet JA4 counted in the fingerprint row above), 6,020,794 connection attempts (~6% of the week). Block dynamically via GreyNoise classification and pair with the JA4 hunt.
3xK Tech GmbH hosting range (US/Germany/Canada); 46 hosts carried the fleet JA4 and identical toolkit this week. Large shared hosting pool, so hunt the fingerprint, do not block the ASN wholesale.

Oracle HTTP Server / WebLogic Server Proxy Plug-in access-control bypass, CVSS 10.0, unauthenticated, scope change, not in CISA KEV. 61 source IPs probing this week (Cloudflare-hosted 32, Bucklog fleet arm 21); ~110 malicious sources over prior 30 days. Emergency-patch candidate.

Gravity SMTP (WordPress plugin) sensitive information exposure, CVSS 7.5, not in CISA KEV. Carried by 56 of the 64 fleet fingerprint hosts this week; broader wave exceeds 1,600 malicious sources over the prior 10 days.

Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway out-of-bounds memory read (CitrixBleed 2), CVSS 7.5, CISA KEV (added 2025-07-09), public exploit available. 300 source IPs this week carried this AND the Palo Alto GlobalProtect login-scanner signature together; all classified malicious. Traffic reached GreyNoise sensors in dozens of countries, Germany most often (351 of 380 signature sources), also US/India/Netherlands/Israel; the German concentration is a sensor-placement artifact, not targeting of German assets.

PureVoltage Hosting, top provider in the 300-host Citrix + Palo Alto cluster (141 hosts). Other providers: Fast Servers / AS43444 (58), Limestone Networks / AS46475 (56), Global Transit Systems / AS213954 (31). Block dynamically and alert on the co-occurring vendor signatures.

WordPress Core SQL injection (WP_Query author__not_in), CVSS 5.9, CISA KEV (added 2026-07-20, inside this analysis window). 112 source IPs on the dedicated signature this week; ~95 after excluding the LeakIX (16) and BinaryEdge (1) research scanners. Hosting-led (DigitalOcean 30, AS14061).

WordPress Core REST API batch endpoint route confusion (Interpretation Conflict), CVSS 9.8, CISA KEV (added 2026-07-20). Chains with CVE-2026-60137 SQL injection to reach remote code execution. 12 source IPs over the prior 30 days (clustered around the 20 July KEV listing), 3 still active this week; all malicious, all on hosting; every one also carried the CVE-2026-60137 signature. Affects 6.9.x < 6.9.5 and 7.0.x < 7.0.2.

Gradio absolute-path traversal file read, CVSS 7.5, not in CISA KEV. Continued probing from Feo Prest host 213.209.159.175 (7,319 probes this week vs a small number of sources worldwide); niche developer surface, bellwether to watch.

React Server Components deserialization RCE, CVSS 10.0, CISA KEV, public exploit available. Persistent since 2026-06-15 brief; 112,058 attempts this week, declining from 189,829 in the 2026-07-13 brief.
PHPUnit RCE, CVSS 9.8, CISA KEV listed. Perennial commodity baseline; WAF-block eval-stdin.php paths where legacy PHP cannot be patched.
PHP-CGI RCE, CVSS 9.8, CISA KEV listed. Commodity baseline, steady vs prior briefs.
PHP-CGI argument injection RCE, CVSS 9.8, CISA KEV listed. Commodity baseline under heavy opportunistic probing.
ThinkPHP LFI, CVSS 9.8, not in CISA KEV. Commodity baseline, steady vs prior briefs.

AS46687, BCI Mississippi Broadband, United States ISP. Single-purpose SSH brute force (30,162 brute-force-tagged) this week; declining about 73% from 2,638,344 in the 2026-07-20 brief. Gate on the brute-force behavior, not ASN or geography. JA4T 29200_2-4-8-1-3_1460_7 is a coarse corroborator only.
